decision_clause: Ruled out: "pin the census ticket-owned path list literally" — because "every remaining product ticket then needs a census edit, and the deletion it was meant to catch is already caught by the focused-lane count guard". Scope: the E0B-001 ticket, packages/schema/src/capability.ts, packages/schema/test/capability.test.ts, specs/adapter-capabilities.v0.json, tests/planning-contract.test.mjs, tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs. Lifecycle: active.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The finished tree is byte-identical to the base tree: diff.patch is zero bytes, and the behaviour the task asked for is absent. packages/schema/src/capability.ts:552-563 still validates evidence_locator with presence + blank checks plus a substring blocklist over FROZEN_RUNTIMES[runtimeId].forbidden only; there is no membership test against the frozen primary/secondary source lists (frozen.primary and frozen.secondary are referenced solely at lines 513-514 when checking the spec's declared source arrays), so a nonempty locator naming an arbitrary undocumented source is still accepted for every PRIMARY/SECONDARY/RUNNER_DERIVED cell on both runtimes. packages/schema/test/capability.test.ts:262-300 still covers only missing, blank, and forbidden-phrase locators — no case asserting acceptance of a declared locator against an approved-source rule and no case rejecting a non-forbidden unapproved locator. Nothing was written into a ticket-owned-path enumeration: tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs:476-495 still re-derives the census from the validator's reported output and compares it to a skeleton-only re-derivation rather than to a hardcoded list, and the focused-lane count guard at tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs:717-756 still carries its unchanged per-lane case counts (including ["capability", 19]).
rationale: The decision forbids guarding the ticket-owned census by writing the path list out literally, on the grounds that the count-based focused-lane guard already catches the deletion case. This implementation adds no such enumeration anywhere, because it adds nothing at all: the recorded change from base to finished tree is empty, and that is corroborated independently by the task's feature being absent from the tree (no approved-source allowlist in capability.ts, no regression tests for accepted-declared or rejected-unapproved locators in capability.test.ts). The census guard sites in scope are untouched — workspace-skeleton.test.mjs still derives the census dynamically from the validator's stdout, and the focused-lane count guard the decision names as the sufficient alternative is still the thing carrying the deletion check. One tension is worth stating plainly rather than hiding: tests/planning-contract.test.mjs:34-35 does pin the validator's ticket_owned_code_paths census as a literal 64-path enumeration inside its accepted/pending output regexes, and that file is inside the recorded scope. But those regexes are pre-existing base-tree state that this implementation neither introduced nor extended; attributing them to this change would be judging the base rather than the implementation. Since no ticket-owned file was added or removed, the change also creates no pressure to edit that enumeration. On what this implementation actually does, it stays outside the ruled-out approach. Approving an empty patch requires no one to re-explain why the literal pin was rejected.
